title: Text API access rules tightened
summary:
A day of text API guardrails, less IP data in feed events, and a small Poly prompt tune-up.

Blocked addresses now receive HTTP 403 from the text API, and rate-limiting rules were adjusted for an integration.

Feed events no longer include the requester's IP address.

Poly's prompt now states an October 2023 knowledge cutoff and allows a Pollinations footer in commercial-blog-style content. The model-context wrapper also gained a way to pass a model override to its generator.
